snippet.title: Tear Them All is OUT NOW! - Free on Steam
snippet.description:
Tear Them All is out and FREE on Steam!

It started as a game jam project, and now it's become my first Steam game.

Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4632380/Tear_Them_All

Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/VyTnePPNAa
